details: Amid intensifying concerns over inflation, primarily fueled by the Iran war and rising energy prices, US Federal Reserve officials are increasingly open to the possibility of raising interest rates. Minutes from the April 28-29 meeting indicate that a growing number of policymakers believe some policy firming would likely become appropriate if inflation remains persistently above the 2% target. Incoming Fed Chair Kevin Warsh faces a challenging environment with surging bond yields, and market expectations suggest no rate cuts, and potentially even hikes, over the next year, a stark contrast to previous projections for cuts.
title: US Federal Reserve Hints at Potential Rate Hikes Amid Inflation Concerns

details: Bitcoin experienced a significant price drop, falling below $75,000, which resulted in over $100 million in liquidations of long positions within a single hour. This decline is part of a broader cryptocurrency market sell-off, with the total crypto market seeing over $400 million in liquidations in the past 24 hours. The downturn is attributed to worsening macroeconomic conditions, elevated treasury yields, and sustained outflows from Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs).
title: Bitcoin Falls Below $75,000, Triggers $100M+ Liquidations

details: The appeal of traditional, lower-risk investments is growing as 10-year treasury yields have reached 4.55%, and 30-year yields are at 5.04%. This increase in risk-free returns makes cryptocurrencies, which are known for their volatility, less attractive to investors. The rising yields are seen as a significant macroeconomic driver causing money to be pulled out of the crypto market, as investors can secure substantial returns without the inherent risks of digital assets.
sourceName: Reddit (r/CryptoCurrency, discussion post citing macro factors)
title: Rising Treasury Yields Divert Capital from Crypto Markets
